current_behavior: The AirBridge serial service UUID remains advertised and the browser uses a service filter in requestDevice().
mdn_basis: MDN documents that acceptAllDevices:true must omit filters and must list needed services in optionalServices; services listed in optionalServices are accessible after user selection.
reason: Changing discovery to acceptAllDevices would broaden the picker and changing GAP to omit the serial UUID would alter first-pairing UX. Without a Flipper and browser BLE picker run, that would be an unverified UX break risk.
future_safe_test: Firmware advertises name/manufacturer data without BLE_SVC_AIRBRIDGE_SERIAL_SERVICE_UUID
Correct device selection connects, getPrimaryService(identity.SERIAL_SERVICE_UUID) succeeds, TX notify subscribes, RX writes 0x42/chat frames
Wrong device selection fails visibly at AirBridge serial BLE service not found without silent hang
